note: One word with a size parameter: 224, 256, 384, 512, 512/224, 512/256. Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode). CyberChef's Rounds parameter is not supported: only the FIPS 180-4 round counts exist.
No parameters. Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode).
No parameters. Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode).
One word with a size parameter in bits: 224, 256, 384, 512. Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode).
One word with a size parameter in bits: 224, 256, 384, 512, with the original Keccak padding (not SHA-3).

The output length is in bytes (1 to 65536, default 64), where CyberChef's Size is in bits (default 512, passed unchanged to the SHAKE function). The variant is 128 or 256 bytes of security strength, as in CyberChef's Capacity.
The output size is in bytes (16, 20, 32, 48 or 64), where CyberChef's Size is in bits (128, 160, 256, 384, 512). The key is an optional key of up to 64 bytes in any of the key encodings.
The output size is in bytes (16, 20 or 32), where CyberChef's Size is in bits (128, 160, 256). The key is an optional key of up to 32 bytes in any of the key encodings.
The output length is in bytes (1 to 65536, default 32; CyberChef's default is 16). The key is an optional 32-byte key, as in CyberChef.

Hash choice: md5, sha1, the SHA-2 sizes including 512/224 and 512/256, the SHA-3 sizes, and ripemd160. Not offered: MD2, MD4, SHA0, RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-256, RIPEMD-320, HAS-160, Whirlpool and Snefru (their digests are not yet in Forge). Blake2 and BLAKE3 keyed modes are their own words.
